caseNameFull: State Automobile Insurance Assn. v. Glick, Administratrix
attorneys: Mr. Guy C. Chambers, with whom Mr. George B. Boland was on the brief, for petitioner. Mr. Herbert Baird, with whom Messrs. Richard F. Stout and Allen W. Field were on the brief, for respondent.

opinions.text:
*697On writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Nebraska.

Per Curiam:

As it appears that the judgment of the state court rested upon a non-federal ground adequate to support it, the writ of certiorari is dismissed as improvidently granted.
